These bearing is a high-precision, four-row linear recirculating ball bearing carriage manufactured by INA. It is designed for monorail guidance systems, offering high load capacity, extreme rigidity, and smooth linear movement. Features four rows of recirculating steel balls arranged in an O-arrangement. This geometric design allows the block to absorb high forces from all directions (tension, compression, and lateral loads) as well as high moment loads around all axes. Material : Manufactured from high-grade, through-hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6). Features are : Interchangeability and Modular Setup, High-Speed and Acceleration Performance, Lubricant Distribution Channels, Reduced Noise, Wide Broad Thermal Range, Extended Service Intervals. Applications : Machine Tools & CNC Equipment, Material Handling Systems, Medical, Laboratory & Cleanroom Technology, Electronic & Semiconductor Assembly, Packaging & Printing Machinery. B=Generation Design, G1=Precision Class 1, V1=Slight Preload.

These bearing is a Linear Bearing is a premium four-row recirculating linear ball bearing carriage. The internal steel balls circulate in four separate tracks. This ensures the carriage can carry heavy loads from all directions (pushing down, pulling up, or pushing from the side). The ball tracks are arranged in a wide \"O\" shape inside the block. This design creates a wide spacing between the load lines, giving the carriage excellent resistance to tipping and twisting moments (high moment rigidity). Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Machine Tooling & Fabrication, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. It is designed for compact monorail systems requiring low height profiles, minimal space usage, and exceptional rigidity. The balls contact the raceways in an \"O\" shape configuration. This specific arrangement provides superior resistance to roll moments and balances load forces equally in all four direction lines: upward, downward, and lateral. Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. These bearing is a high-performance four-row linear recirculating ball bearing carriage manufactured by INA. It features an expanded type design with a full complement ball configuration, meaning it lacks a ball chain to maximize the number of load-bearing rolling elements. This block features four rows of balls arranged in an O-configuration. This design provides high rigidity and exceptional moment-load capacities across all axes. Features are : Low Wave Travel Motion, Flexible Maintenance Access, Integrated Lubrication Channels, Operating Temperature Limits, Interchangeable Modular Design, Low Kinetic Friction, High-Speed Performance & Acceleration. Applications : Machine Tools and Metalworking, Medical and Laboratory Equipment, Semiconductor and Electronics Manufacturing, Packaging and Printing Technology, Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing, Woodworking Machinery, Renewable Energy Production. These bearing is a high-performance four-row linear recirculating ball bearing carriage manufactured by INA. This narrow, standard-length runner block is engineered for monorail guidance systems that require heavy load support, high rigidity, and minimal friction. The balls contact the raceways in an \"O\" shape configuration. This specific arrangement provides superior resistance to roll moments and balances load forces equally in all four direction lines: upward, downward, and lateral. Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Machine Tooling & Fabrication, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. subName: LINEAR BALL BEARING BUSHES & SHAFT GUIDES
tech: The KSO...PP is a heavy-duty linear ball bearing manufactured by INA. It belongs to the heavy-duty series (Series 3) of linear guidance systems and features an open design with built-in self-alignment capability. It features a sector cutout (opening) that allows the bearing to slide smoothly along continuously supported shafts. This design is crucial for long-travel machinery where unsupported shafts would sag or bend under load. The bearing can automatically adjust for angular misalignments up to ±40 angular minutes. This minimizes friction, prevents edge binding, and accommodates minor mounting inaccuracies or shaft deflections. Material : Made with high-carbon hardened chrome steel rolling elements housed inside a low-friction polyamide cage with durable polyurethane lip seals. Features are : High Load Capacity, Lubrication Outer Groove, Temperature Range, Reduced Friction, Predictable Service Life, Low Initial Breakaway Torque, Maximum Acceleration Profile. Applications : CNC Machinery & Metalworking, Material Handling & Logistics, Industrial Printing & Paper Presses, Medical Positioning Equipment, Construction Machinery. PP=Lip Seal On Both Sides Of The Bearing.

These ball bushings have the same boundary dimensions as the standard ball bushings and are usually interchangeable. The additional ball circuits enable higher load capacities. Super ball bushings offer the advantage of being able to correct slight errors in alignment. The outer diameter varies along the length making them slightly barrel shaped. It is this shaping that enables it to self align. The self alignment feature also means that there is no reduction in load capacity due to pressure between the bushing edge and the shaft. The ball tracks are ground and consequently the bushes run smoothly. Speeds of up to 3m/s are possible.

These rotating and sliding ball bushings allow both types
of high precision motion. These motions can occur either
separately or simultaneously. Given the same shaft size, the
outside diameter of these ball bushings is much smaller than
a combination of a standard ball bushing and a radial ball or
roller bearing. These bushes are in two forms: 0662 Series with brass cage & RK series with circlip grooves in outer ring & steel cage. 0662 & RK00 do not have a flange, while RK20 has a square flange but no circlip grooves.

desc: OPEN SIDED ALUMINIUM HOUSINGS FOR LINEAR BEARINGS
tech: When the direction of the load is acting towards the open side of an Open Type Ball Bushing the load capacity is severely reduced. These Open Sided Linear Sets have been developed to overcome this disadvantage and to permit selective circumferential positioning as well as high rigidity of the open type ball bushing assembly. The Linear Housing Unit has been dimensioned so that optimum bracing and load-bearing capacity is achieved when forces are applied from the side. The aluminum bearing unit is fitted as standard with sealed standard ball bushings.

The LME bearing is a linear ball bushing bearing manufactured by NATEC Japan. LME Series, featuring a solid steel outer cylinder, a ball retainer, balls, and two end rings. Features are : Ultra-low friction performance, Self-aligning:, Interchangeability, High Precision and Rigidity, Durability, Low Noise Operation, Ease of Assembly, Load Resistance, High Reliability, Double rubber seals, Extra-long design. LUU: This indicates that the bearing is a \"long type\" and has lip seals on both sides.

OP : The open side types have a relief arc cut out of the the outer raceway to allow installation on T type guide rails (see technical tab). Features are : Wide range of installation options with LM type rails, low friction, low maintenance, rubber seal limits moisture and dirt ingress,cost effective solution.

tech: Linear motion bearing (also known as a linear bushing) manufactured by Harhues & Teufert\'s . The \"LM\" in the part number indicates it\'s a linear motion bushing, designed to facilitate smooth, low-friction linear movement when used with a cylindrical shaft. The \"AJ\" signifies that this is an adjustable linear bushing. This means you can adjust the clearance between the bushing and the shaft, which can be crucial for achieving the desired precision and minimizing play in your application. The \"UU\" indicates that the bushing is sealed at both ends. Features are : Standardized & Interchangeable, Solid Steel Outer Cylinder, Industrial Strength Resin Retainer, Low Friction & Smooth Motion, Load Capacity & Long Life, Low Noise Operation. Applications : These bearings are widely used in a variety of industries, including : 3D printers, Electronic equipment, Food machinery, Packaging machinery, Medical machinery, Printing machinery, Textile machinery, Machinery, instruments, and robots, CNC machine tools, Automotive and digital 3D coordinate measuring equipment.

The KB series is a ball bushing or linear ball bearing from Harhues & Teufert machined range. These ball bushings are particularly durable and they have a high running accuracy. The balls run with great precision thanks to a special spring washer. The result is low and even displacement resistance, also under severe operating conditions and regardless of the installed position. The closed design makes this bearing suitable for use on unsupported shafts. The outer ring accommodates a plastic cage and balls. When the ball bushing is in motion, the rolling elements follow a trajectory returning through openings in the outer ring. Applications : Automation & Robotics, CNC and Machine Tools, Measurement & Inspection Equipment, Packaging & Pick & Place, Medical Devices & Laboratory Equipment, Printing & Imaging, General Machinery & Conveyors.

The result is low and even displacement resistance, also under severe operating conditions and regardless of the installed position. The closed design makes this bearing suitable for use on unsupported shafts. The outer ring accommodates a plastic cage and balls. When the ball bushing is in motion, the rolling elements follow a trajectory returning through openings in the outer ring. Applications : Automation & Robotics, CNC and Machine Tools, Measurement & Inspection Equipment, Packaging & Pick & Place, Medical Devices & Laboratory Equipment, Printing & Imaging, General Machinery & Conveyors. PP : Lip Seal On Both Sides Of The Bearing, AS : Lubrication Holes In The Outer Ring Or Lubrication Groove In The Housing.

The MAM series aims to provide higher rigidity, better load capacity, and longer travel life than conventional ball bushings. The bearings patented ball control technology eliminates binding and chatter (stick-slip), common with high friction, plain bearings. It is designed to reduce bending & deflection under load. These are round-shaft linear bearings, meaning they use a cylindrical shaft (round rail) and the MAM bearing slides along it using recirculating balls. Higher rigidity & lower deflection: Compared to some simpler ball bushings, the MAM design is optimized for stiffer response. Sealed versions guard against contamination and grease leakage, improving lifespan in hostile environments. Self-aligning variants reduce binding when shaft alignment is imperfect.

RJZM is a series of linear plain bearings or closed bushing style plain bushings. Closed means the bushing is enclosed (not open & slotted), so it fully surrounds the shaft on all sides, providing better containment of the bearing liner and often better protection.  These bearings use liner material (usually a polymer or self-lubricating plastic) rather than rolling elements. Thus sliding contact between shaft and liner.Commonly used with a housing or adapter (sometimes aluminium) that holds the liner; sometimes with retaining clips. Liner materials have maximum long-term temperature limits (for iglide R or J variants ~ +90 °C or above depending on variant) and short-term peaks higher.Often more compact cross-section and simpler design, especially for long travel or when dust/debris would damage ball bearings. Lower maintenance and Quieter and smoother in many cases (sliding contact). Able to handle dust, contaminants better if liner is of polymer and the bearing is closed.

RJUM is a series of closed linear plain bearings (“Closed” meaning the bearing liner is fully enclosed in an adapter and housing, not open or slotted). They are designed to be dimensionally compatible with certain recirculating ball bearings, i.e. they often match the standard outer, inner or length dimensions so they can be swapped (in some cases) without changing the mechanical envelope. They use a polymer liner, inside an aluminum adapter (anodized). This gives a self-lubricating sliding bearing rather than rolling elements. Features are : Low maintenance, Quiet and smooth motion, Compact design, Lightweight, Flexibility and replaceability, Compatibility.

It is a linear slide bearing or plain bushing type, using a polymer liner inside an aluminum adapter, intended for self-lubricating, low maintenance operation. Often used as a replacement or alternative for recirculating ball bearings in linear motion systems when lower noise, simpler design, or better performance in dusty and contaminant environments is desired. It uses a polymer liner (iglide J), no external lubrication is typically required. The long-term temperature limit is about +90 °C, and short-term peaks can go higher. Compatible with anodized aluminum, case-hardened steel, stainless steel, cold-rolled steel, etc. Features are : Good for dusty or dirty environments, Quite and  smoother operation, Light weight, Self-lubricating, Maintenance-free.

It uses a polymer liner (iglide J), no external lubrication is typically required. The long-term temperature limit is about +90 °C, and short-term peaks can go higher. Compatible with anodized aluminum, case-hardened steel, stainless steel, cold-rolled steel, etc. Features are : Good for dusty or dirty environments, Quite and  smoother operation, Light weight, Self-lubricating, Maintenance-free.

RJUM is a series of closed linear plain bearings (“Closed” meaning the bearing liner is fully enclosed in an adapter and housing, not open or slotted). They are designed to be dimensionally compatible with certain recirculating ball bearings, i.e. they often match the standard outer, inner or length dimensions so they can be swapped (in some cases) without changing the mechanical envelope. They use a polymer liner, inside an aluminum adapter (anodized). This gives a self-lubricating sliding bearing rather than rolling elements. Features are : Low maintenance, Quiet and smooth motion, Compact design, Lightweight, Flexibility and replaceability, Compatibility.

RJZM is a series of linear plain bearings or closed bushing style plain bushings. Closed means the bushing is enclosed (not open & slotted), so it fully surrounds the shaft on all sides, providing better containment of the bearing liner and often better protection.  These bearings use liner material (usually a polymer or self-lubricating plastic) rather than rolling elements. Thus sliding contact between shaft and liner.Commonly used with a housing or adapter (sometimes aluminium) that holds the liner; sometimes with retaining clips. Liner materials have maximum long-term temperature limits (for iglide R or J variants ~ +90 °C or above depending on variant) and short-term peaks higher.Often more compact cross-section and simpler design, especially for long travel or when dust/debris would damage ball bearings. Lower maintenance and Quieter and smoother in many cases (sliding contact). Able to handle dust, contaminants better if liner is of polymer and the bearing is closed.

By using a housing unit, the linear bearing is protected from contaminants and the overall system is more stable and secure. Features are : Good lubricant retention, Standardized design, Load distribution, Interchangeability, Mounting flexibility, Corrosion resistance, Protection for internal components, Simplified maintenance, Ease of installation, Robust construction, Low friction. Applications : CNC machines and 3D printers, Industrial robots, Conveyor systems, Packaging equipment, Material handling, Woodworking machinery, Aerospace, Chemical industry, Laboratory automation.

It is different from a ball bearing, which enables circular motion. It operates by sliding along a surface rather than rolling. Material : Bearing steel, a tough and durable steel alloy commonly used for bearings. Features are : High load capacity, Contamination resistance, Durability and lifespan, Environmental performance, Shock and impact resistance, Low maintenance, Quiet operation, Compact structure. Applications : Assembly lines, Construction equipment, Agricultural and mining equipment, Hydraulic steel structures, Medical and laboratory equipment, Food and beverage industry, Robotics, CNC machines, Packaging machinery, Aerospace, Textile and woodworking machinery.

The Nadella LML series s a specific linear motion bearing designed to allow precise, backlash-free linear movement along a shaft. It is a component of Nadella\'s LML linear guide system, intended for applications with light to medium loads where compact dimensions and economy are important. Linear motion ball bearing (specifically using four revolving ball tracks). It\'s a key component within the LML linear guide system which often uses guide rollers or ball tracks, depending on the exact design. Enables smooth, linear movement and is capable of absorbing high radial forces. Material: The rolling elements are made of hardened and ground bearing steel, housed in a polymer retainer, with the mating guide rail being extruded and anodized aluminum with pressed-in steel shafts. Features four internal revolving ball tracks held in place by a polymer housing. The design is typically long, which is ideal for use under torque loads. Features are : Backlash-free movement, High radial load absorption, Smooth and low-noise operation, Sealed on both sides, Integrated lubrication system. Applications : Automation and Robotics, Medical and Food Engineering, Packaging Machinery, Printing Machinery, Woodworking Machinery.

The SAMICK LMES is an open-type, self-aligning linear ball bearing, designed for precise linear motion systems in industrial applications. This is a European standard (LME) type linear bushing, generally interchangeable with other standard linear bushings. It is an \"open\" version, intended for use in applications where the shaft is supported by additional linear guides or needs clearance adjustment. The bearing is designed with self-aligning ball plates that can compensate for minor misalignments (up to ±0.5˚) between the shaft and the housing bore, simplifying installation and reducing potential binding or wear. Material: The outer sleeve is made from high-carbon chromium bearing steel, with grinding processes applied after heat treatment. The rolling elements (balls) are also high-carbon bearing steel (SUJ2). Features are : High-Speed Performance, Exceptional Load Capacity, Energy Efficiency, Simplified Lubrication, Smooth & Quiet Operation, Lightweight and Noise-Dampening. Applications : CNC Machinery and 3D Printers, Packaging and Printing Machinery, Material Handling and Assembly. N=Electroless Nickel Plating, OP=Open Type.

The LMBS SAMICK BEARING is a self-aligning linear bushing following the US standard (inch) dimensions, featuring specific anti-corrosion plating. The \'N\' indicates an electroless nickel plating for rust prevention. The LMBS series from Samick is designed for smooth, high-precision linear motion with unlimited stroke length when used with an LM shaft. The key feature is the self-aligning ball plate which allows for alignment variations of up to ±0.5°, ensuring uniform load distribution and low friction even with minor mounting inaccuracies or shaft deflection. Material : The outer sleeve is made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel, with inner and outer grinding processes applied after heat treatment. The balls are made of high carbon steel (SUJ2), and the retainer is typically polymer. Features  are : Corrosion Resistance, High Load Capacity, Smooth and Silent Operation, Low Friction, Adjustable Clearance, High Travel Speeds. Applications : Aerospace and Automotive, Medical & Laboratory equipment, Hydraulic and Pneumatic related industries, Material Handling and Logistics, Textile Manufacturing & Paper Making Machinery.

The Samick LM linear bearing is a high-precision, closed-type linear motion ball bushing designed for precise and reliable movement. It is characterized by low friction, high rigidity, and standardized dimensions, making it fully interchangeable for easy maintenance. The bearing consists of an outer steel cylinder, a ball retainer, hardened steel balls, and two end rings. The ball retainer guides the balls in a recirculating path, which provides rolling contact with the shaft for stable, low-friction linear motion. Material : The outer casing is typically made of chromium steel, and the internal ball retainer is made of a strong industrial-strength resin or polymer, balancing durability with efficient ball guidance. Features are : High Precision, Contamination Resistance, Low Friction, High Accuracy, Ease of Assembly, Reliable Performance, High Load Distribution. Applications : 3D Printers and CNC Machines, Robotics and Automation, Precision and Measuring Equipment, Packaging and Printing Machinery, DIY Mechanical Projects, Textile Machinery, Medical Machinery, Power Tools. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The Samick LMAJ-N is a precision adjustable, open-type linear ball bushing (bearing) from the Asian Standard (LM) series. The \"AJ\" signifies adjustable clearance, while the \"N\" denotes that the internal ball plates (retainers) have undergone electroless nickel plating for enhanced corrosion resistance, a key feature for use in specific environmental conditions. It facilitates unlimited linear travel along a compatible LM shaft with minimal friction, due to the balls having point contact with the shaft. Material : The outer sleeve and balls are typically made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2) for durability and wear resistance. The retainer is typically made of a durable polymer (resin), though steel retainers are an option for high-temperature or vacuum environments. Features are : Low Friction & High Precision, Unlimited Stroke, Self-Alignment Capability, High Accuracy and Repeatability, Wide Temperature Range, Quiet and Smooth Motion. Applications : CNC Machinery, 3D Printers & Laser Cutters, Food and Packaging Machinery, Medical Equipment, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Material Handling, Printing Machines.

The Samick LMFUU is a flanged linear ball bushing that facilitates precise, low-friction linear motion using rolling elements. Key engineering aspects include its high-carbon chromium steel construction, four-row ball circuit design for even load distribution, and a built-in circular flange for secure, easy mounting. The bearing uses a system where hardened steel balls roll in four precise circuits along the guide shaft. This point contact drastically reduces friction, which minimizes the difference between static and dynamic friction, preventing stick-slip. Material : High carbon steel (SUJ2) for the outer sleeve and balls. Features are : High-Performance Rolling Mechanism, High Precision & Repeatability, Space-Efficient Mounting, Self-Alignment Capability, Maintenance-Free Potential, Energy Efficiency, Noise Reduction, Standardized Interchangeability. Applications : 3D Printers and CNC Machinery, Automated Machinery, Medical Equipment, Laboratory Automation, Textile Machinery, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Food Processing Equipment, Material Handling Systems. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The bearing uses a system where hardened steel balls roll in four precise circuits along the guide shaft. This point contact drastically reduces friction, which minimizes the difference between static and dynamic friction, preventing stick-slip. Material : High carbon steel (SUJ2) for the outer sleeve and balls. Features are : High-Performance Rolling Mechanism, High Precision & Repeatability, Space-Efficient Mounting, Self-Alignment Capability, Maintenance-Free Potential, Energy Efficiency, Noise Reduction, Standardized Interchangeability. Applications : 3D Printers and CNC Machinery, Automated Machinery, Medical Equipment, Laboratory Automation, Textile Machinery, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Food Processing Equipment, Material Handling Systems. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The Samick LMFU bearing is a circular flanged linear ball bushing designed for precise linear motion systems. The Samick LMF series linear bushings are designed to provide high precision, low friction linear motion with unlimited stroke when used with a cylindrical LM shaft. The balls in the loaded area of the bearing are in point contact with the shaft, which minimizes friction resistance. The outer cylinder and the flange are integrated, allowing for easy, direct bolt-on mounting to a housing without needing additional accessories. Material : The use of high-carbon steel for both the outer sleeve and the balls contributes to a long operational life and durability. Features are : Self-Alignment Capability, Minimal Static and Dynamic Friction, High-Speed Operation, Standardized Interchangeability, High Load Capacity Options. Applications : 3D Printers and CNC Machines, Industrial Automation and Robotics, Packaging and Food Processing Machinery, Medical Equipment, Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, Textile Machinery, Office Automation Equipment. The Samick LMF-N is a precision flanged linear ball bushing designed for smooth, accurate linear motion, featuring electroless nickel plating for superior corrosion resistance. It operates on the principle of point contact between the steel balls and the linear shaft, which minimizes friction and allows for high-precision movement with unlimited stroke length when used with a compatible linear shaft. Material: High carbon steel (SUJ2) with electroless nickel plating, retainer, steel. Features are : Corrosion Resistance, Smooth & Precise Motion, Easy Installation, Wide Operating Temperature, Standardized & Interchangeable, Low Friction Operation, High Rigidity. Applications : 3D Printers and CNC Machines, Multi-Axis Drilling Machines, Printing and Packaging Machinery, Material Handling Systems, Food Processing Machines, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Vacuum Equipment, Textile Machinery, Automotive Components. N= Electroless Nickel Plating.

The Samick LMF-S bearing is a round-flanged linear ball bearing from Samick\'s Asian Standard Linear Bushing series, known for its high precision and low friction. The LMF designation indicates a flanged linear ball bushing (meaning it has a circular flange for mounting with bolts). The round flange is an integrated part of the bearing, which simplifies mounting and installation as it can be directly bolted into place without requiring an additional housing unit. Material : Outer sleeve and balls: High carbon chromium steel (SUJ2); Retainer: Polymer/resin. Features are : High Precision and Rigidity, High-Speed Operation, Standardized Interchangeability, Self-Alignment Capability, Optimal Load Distribution, Ease of Maintenance, Low Noise and Smooth Operation. Applications : Medical Devices and Lab Automation, Food and Beverage Processing, Material Handling Systems, Optical and Scientific Equipment, Woodworking Machinery, 3D Printing and Additive Manufacturing, CNC Machinery, Measuring and Inspection Equipment, Packaging Equipment, Textile Machinery, Office Automation. S=Stainless Steel Ball.

The SAMICK LMFLUU is a long-type, circular flanged linear ball bearing designed for high-precision, low-friction linear motion in applications like 3D printers, CNC machines, and robotics. Its robust construction allows it to handle significant loads and provides full interchangeability with other standardized linear bearings. The outer cylinder is made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2) which is heat-treated and precision-ground on inner and outer diameters to ensure sufficient harness and projected travel life. The balls are also made from bearing steel, while the ball retainer is typically made from a durable resin (polymer) to guide the ball circuits smoothly. A steel retainer is an optional alternative for high-temperature or vacuum environments. Features are : Minimised Friction and Stick-Slip Elimination, Ease of Assembly, High Load Capacity, Compatibility, High Speed and Acceleration. Applications : Multi-axis machine tools, Printing machines, Food packaging machines, Electronic equipment manufacturing, Medical and laboratory equipment, Material Handling Systems, Agricultural Automation. U=One Side Seal.

The SAMICK LMK-A bearing is an Asian standard, square-flanged linear bushing designed for precision shafts. Material : Outer sleeve and balls are made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2), which is heat-treated and ground on both inner and outer surfaces for maximum rigidity and precision. Features are : Compact Rigid Structure, Standardized Interchangeability, Low Friction Resistance, Vacuum Compatibility, Minimized Stick-Slip, High Precision Motion, Life-Extending Orientation, Stick-Slip Prevention, Interchangeability. Applications : Medical Equipment, CNC Machinery & 3D Printers, Robotics & Factory Automation, Packaging & Processing, Semiconductor Processing Equipment, Multi-Axis Drilling Machines.

Standard resin (POM) for general use or optional stainless steel for high-temperature or vacuum environments. Features are : Low Friction Resistance, Minimal Stick-Slip, Standardized Interchangeability, High Rigidity Long Design, Moment Load Stability, Load Direction Optimization, Quiet Operation, Minimized Heat Generation, Strict Tolerance Control. Applications : 3D Measuring Equipments, Medical Instruments, Auto Recording Equipments, Food Packaging Machines, Multi-Axis Drilling & Punching, Printing & Textile Machinery, 3D Printers & CNC Machines, Cleanrooms & Vacuum Chambers, Woodworking Equipment, Pneumatic Cylinder Guides. L=Extra Long, U=One Side Seal.

The SAMICK LMFP...UU bearing is a specialized Asian standard pilot-flanged linear motion ball bearing. The \"P\" in the model name indicates a pilot flange design, which provides more stable movement and is particularly suitable for applications with moment loads. The pilot flange design allows for installation without a separate housing and ensures stability when the moving load is passed directly to the bushing. Material : A high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2) outer sleeve and balls, typically paired with a resin (polymer) retainer for standard use. Features are : Standardized Interchangeability, Recirculating Ball System, High Precision & Low Friction, Quiet and Smooth Operation, High-Speed Stability, Ease of Maintenance, Space-Saving Design, High-Temperature. Applications : Semiconductor Manufacturing, Packaging Machinery, 3D Printing and CNC Machinery, Pharmaceutical Machinery, Textile & Printing Machinery, Office Equipment, Automotive Assembly. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The pilot part of the flange is designed to fit precisely into a mounting hole, ensuring high axial alignment and rigidity. Material : A high-carbon chromium bearing steel outer sleeve and a resin retainer (standard) or steel retainer (for high-temperature/vacuum environments). Features are : Moment Load Stability, Self-Alignment Capability, Unlimited Stroke, Low Friction & No Stick-Slip, Standardized Interchangeability, Dynamic Life Calculation, High-Speed movement, Maintenance & Compatibility. Applications : CNC Machinery, Factory Automation, Textile & Printing Machinery, Medical and Scientific Instruments, Food and Packaging Machinery, Aerospace and Defense, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Material Handling & Logistics. L=Extra Long, A=Steel Retainer.

The Samick LMKP....UU bearing is an Asian Standard linear bushing distinguished by its pilot flanged design, which provides superior stability for moment loads and simplified mounting compared to standard flanged types. This bearing is a recirculating ball type designed to provide low-friction linear motion. The pilot flange design is specifically suited for applications where the load of a moving body is passed directly to the bushing, offering more stable movement than standard flanged types. Material : High carbon steel (SUJ2) outer sleeve and balls with a polymer (resin) retainer. Features are : High Precision Fitting, Minimal Friction Variance, Infinite Stroke Capability, Low Friction & Noise, Shaft Compatibility, Ease of Installation, Four-Row Ball Circuit. Applications : 3D Measuring Equipment, CNC Machine Tools, Specialized Industrial Machines, Printing & Packaging Machinery, Textile & Tobacco Machinery, Semiconductor Handling, Aerospace Testing, Multi-Axis Drilling & Punching. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The flange and outer cylinder are integrated, featuring a \"pilot\" (a precise circular extension) that allows the bearing to be centered directly into a bored hole for superior alignment. Material : Both the outer sleeve and the balls are made from SUJ2 (High Carbon Chromium Bearing Steel) with a polymer (resin) retainer. Features are : Low Friction & High Precision, Compact Oval Profile, Standardized Interchangeability, Travel Life & Load Ratings, Operating Temperature, Optimized Clearance, Unlimited Stroke, Smooth High-Speed Operation, Simplified Installation. Applications : 3D Printing & Additive Manufacturing, Medical & Diagnostic Equipment, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Food & Packaging Machinery, CNC Machinery and Measuring Instruments. S=Stainless Steel Ball.

The Samick LMHPL...UU bearing is an Asian Standard, long-type linear bushing featuring an oval pilot flange designed for stable movement and high load capacity. Linear motion system typically used in precision equipment like 3D printers, CNC machines, and measuring devices. This design allows the bushing to be installed without a separate housing and is particularly suited for handling moment loads. Material : The outer sleeve and balls are made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2)  and a resin (POM) retainer for quiet operation. Features are : Low Friction & High Precision,Unlimited Linear Stroke, No Stick-Slip, High-Speed Travel, Shaft Alignment, Temperature Range, Lubrication and Maintenance. Applications : 3D Measuring Equipments, Medical Technology, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Food & Pharmaceutical Packaging, CNC Machines, Textile Machinery, Multi-Axis Drilling & Punching, Printing & Paper Processing, Aerospace & Defense. L=Extra Long, UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The SAMICK LMFM...UU bearing is a specialized Asian standard linear bushing featuring a middle-flange design, specifically engineered for precision linear motion shafts. Unlike standard flanged bearings where the flange is at one end, the \"M\" in LMFM indicates that the flange is positioned in the middle of the bearing body, allowing for more stable mounting when passing through a moving body. Material : High-carbon Chromium Bearing Steel (GCR15), heat-treated to a hardness of HRC 60–64 for long service life and a resin (POM) retainer for quiet operation. Features are : Low-Friction Point Contact, Circulating Ball Paths, Moment Load Optimization, High Positioning Accuracy, Standardized Interchangeability, High-Speed Travel, Lubrication and Maintenance, Installation and Tolerances, Simplified Assembly, Space Optimization. Applications : Packaging & Textiles Machinery, Medical & Diagnostic Devices, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Laboratory and Medical Automation, Food and Chemical Processing, 3D Printing & Prototyping, Mass Production Machinery. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

Material : High-carbon Chromium Bearing Steel (GCR15), heat-treated to a hardness of HRC 60–64 for long service life and a resin (POM) retainer for quiet operation. Features are : Low-Friction Point Contact, Circulating Ball Paths, Moment Load Optimization, High Positioning Accuracy, Standardized Interchangeability, High-Speed Travel, Lubrication and Maintenance, Installation and Tolerances, Simplified Assembly, Space Optimization. Applications : Packaging & Textiles Machinery, Medical & Diagnostic Devices, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Laboratory and Medical Automation, Food and Chemical Processing, 3D Printing & Prototyping, Mass Production Machinery. S=Stainless Steel Ball.

The Samick LMKM...UU bearing is an Asian Standard, middle-pilot flanged linear bushing specifically engineered for high-precision linear motion systems. Unlike standard linear bearings that require a separate housing, this model integrates a square flange into the middle of the outer sleeve, allowing it to be bolted directly to a mounting surface for simplified assembly and improved stability. The square middle flange simplifies assembly by allowing the bearing to be bolted directly to a surface, making it ideal for managing moment loads. Material : The outer sleeve and balls are made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2)  and a resin (POM) retainer for quiet operation. Features are : Low-Friction Motion, High Speed & Acceleration, Precision Ball Circuits, Unlimited Stroke, Lubrication and Maintenance, Standardized Interchangeability, Service Life Factors. Applications : Precision & Measuring Equipment, CNC Machine Tools, Automated Production Lines, Packaging & Food Machinery, Printing Machinery, Textile Machinery, Medical & Lab Equipment. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

Unlike standard linear bearings that require a separate housing, this model integrates a square flange into the middle of the outer sleeve, allowing it to be bolted directly to a mounting surface for simplified assembly and improved stability. The square middle flange simplifies assembly by allowing the bearing to be bolted directly to a surface, making it ideal for managing moment loads. Material : The outer sleeve and balls are made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2)  and a resin (POM) retainer for quiet operation. Features are : Low-Friction Motion, High Speed & Acceleration, Precision Ball Circuits, Unlimited Stroke, Lubrication and Maintenance, Standardized Interchangeability, Service Life Factors. Applications : Precision & Measuring Equipment, CNC Machine Tools, Automated Production Lines, Packaging & Food Machinery, Printing Machinery, Textile Machinery, Medical & Lab Equipment. The LMH...UU bearing is a specialized middle-flanged linear motion bushing from Samick, specifically designed for stable movement when loads are passed directly to the bushing body. This model features an oval middle flange that allows for secure mounting without the need for a separate housing, making it ideal for compact systems requiring precise axial movement. The unit contains 4 ball circuits for smooth recirculation. Material : Constructed from high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2), which is heat-treated and precision-ground for durability. Standard units use a polymer (resin) retainer for low noise. Features are : High-Capacity Load Rating, Infinite Linear Stroke, Zero Stick-Slip, Standardized Interchangeability, Low Friction Operation, Ease of Installation, High Speed and Quiet Operation, Flexible Lubrication, Pre-Lubricated Systems. Applications : 3D Printers and CNC Machinery, Packaging Equipment, Textile & Printing Machinery, Medical Equipment, Measuring & Inspection Tools, Semiconductor Fabrication, Food & Beverage Processing, Aerospace & Defense. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

This model features an oval middle flange that allows for secure mounting without the need for a separate housing, making it ideal for compact systems requiring precise axial movement. The unit contains 4 ball circuits for smooth recirculation. Material : Constructed from high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2), which is heat-treated and precision-ground for durability. Standard units use a polymer (resin) retainer for low noise. Features are : High-Capacity Load Rating, Infinite Linear Stroke, Zero Stick-Slip, Standardized Interchangeability, Low Friction Operation, Ease of Installation, High Speed and Quiet Operation, Flexible Lubrication, Pre-Lubricated Systems. Applications : 3D Printers and CNC Machinery, Packaging Equipment, Textile & Printing Machinery, Medical Equipment, Measuring & Inspection Tools, Semiconductor Fabrication, Food & Beverage Processing, Aerospace & Defense. The Samick LME...UU bearing is a precision European standard (metric) linear ball bushing designed for low-friction, high-speed movement. It features a robust high-carbon steel construction and is widely used in CNC machinery, 3D printers, and automated assembly lines. Unlike multi-piece retainers, Samick uses a single-body integrally molded retainer. This design accurately guides 4 to 6 ball circuits, ensuring stable running accuracy and preventing ball clustering during high-speed travel. Material : High-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2) for the outer sleeve and balls, with a polymer retainer for standard operation. Features are : High Rigidity and Precision, Point Contact Friction Control, Shaft Hardness Factor, Low Heat Generation, Acceleration Tolerance, Specialized Maintenance & Life Cycle, Mounting & Fit Flexibility. Applications : Printing and Packaging, Food and Pharmaceutical Packing, Textile and Woodworking Machinery, Medical & Laboratory Systems, Aerospace & Defense, Material Testing Machines. The SAMICK LMEL...UU bearing is a high-performance, long-body linear bushing. It follows the European Metric Standard and is designed for applications requiring extended guidance, higher load distribution, and minimal friction. It utilizes five rows of recirculating steel balls to ensure balanced load distribution and smooth travel. Material : Made from hardened and precisely ground SUJ2 (high-carbon chromium bearing steel) for maximum rigidity and wear resistance. Standard models use a polymer/resin retainer to ensure low noise and smooth operation. Features are : Self-Lubricating Capacity, High Rigidity under Moment Loads, Precision & Tolerances, High Load-to-Weight Ratio, Reduced Friction Torque, Submicron Feeding, Standardized Mounting, Ease of Integration. Applications : Pick-and-Place Robots, Automated Packaging, CNC Machining Centers, 3D Printing, Medical & Laboratory Equipment, Woodworking Machinery, Textile Manufacturing, Automotive & Transportation, Cleanroom & Food Processing, Aerospace Wind Tunnels. L=Extra Long, UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

It follows the European Metric Standard and is designed for applications requiring extended guidance, higher load distribution, and minimal friction. It utilizes five rows of recirculating steel balls to ensure balanced load distribution and smooth travel. Material : Made from hardened and precisely ground SUJ2 (high-carbon chromium bearing steel) for maximum rigidity and wear resistance. Standard models use a polymer/resin retainer to ensure low noise and smooth operation. Features are : Self-Lubricating Capacity, High Rigidity under Moment Loads, Precision & Tolerances, High Load-to-Weight Ratio, Reduced Friction Torque, Submicron Feeding, Standardized Mounting, Ease of Integration. Applications : Pick-and-Place Robots, Automated Packaging, CNC Machining Centers, 3D Printing, Medical & Laboratory Equipment, Woodworking Machinery, Textile Manufacturing, Automotive & Transportation, Cleanroom & Food Processing, Aerospace Wind Tunnels. L=Extra Long, A=Steel Retainer.

The SAMICK LME..UUAJ bearing is a precision-engineered linear motion ball bushing designed to meet European metric standards. The \"AJ\" suffix signifies its adjustable clearance design, which features a longitudinal slit that allows for fine-tuning the radial clearance between the bearing and the shaft when mounted in an adjustable housing. Material : The outer sleeve and balls are typically made from high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2). It usually comes with a polymer (resin) retainer for standard low-noise operation. Features are : Misalignment Compensation, Point Contact Ball System, High Rigidity with Minimal Friction, Enhanced Surface Treatments, Load Rating Baseline, Maintenance & Lubrication, Low Friction & No Stick-Slip, High Acceleration Tolerance. Applications : 3D Measuring Instruments, Laboratory Automation, CNC Machinery, Semiconductor Manufacturing, 3D Printing & Additive Manufacturing, Packaging & Textile Machinery, Medical & Scientific Devices, Woodworking and Cutting. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The Samick LMEF...UU bearing is a precision-engineered, European-standard circular flanged linear bearing. It features an integrated mounting flange that allows for direct installation onto a machine surface, eliminating the need for a separate bearing housing while providing high rigidity and low friction. The flange is connected directly to the outer cylinder, allowing the load of a moving body to pass directly to the bushing. This design facilitates installation on a flat surface without requiring a separate housing. Material : Constructed from high carbon bearing steel (SUJ2) for high hardness and extended travel life. Standard models use a polymer (POM/resin) retainer; a steel retainer is optional for high-temperature or vacuum applications. Features are : Recirculating Ball Circuits, High Precision and Rigidity, Smooth High-Speed Operation, Moment Load Suitability, Standardized Interchangeability, Lubrication Requirements. Applications : CNC Machinery, 3D Printing & Additive Manufacturing, Packaging & Food Processing, Medical Devices, Printing & Textile Machinery, Multi-Axis Drilling & Punching, Textile & Paper Processing. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

Material: High-carbon bearing steel (SUJ2) with a resin retainer as standard. Features are : Standardized Interchangeability, Low Friction running, Precision and Tolerances, Submicron Feeding, Self-Lubricating Potential, Recirculating Ball Circuits, Load Ratings, Operating Speed. Applications : CNC Machinery, Packaging and Labeling, Conveyor Systems, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Medical Equipment, Aerospace and Defense, Food Processing, Textile and Printing, Fitness and Rehabilitation. L=Extra Long, U=One Side Seal.

The SAMICK LMEK...UU bearings is a specialized European-standard linear ball bearing that incorporates a square flange for direct mounting. It is designed for applications requiring high precision, such as CNC machines and 3D printers, where it provides smooth, low-friction motion. Material : The outer sleeve and balls are made from high-carbon Chromium Bearing Steel (SUJ2), which undergoes specialized heat treatment and precision grinding to ensure high rigidity and a long service life.  The standard version uses a Resin (Polymer) retainer, though a steel retainer. Features are : Standardised Mounting Holes, European Metric Standards, Minimal Friction, Space Efficiency, Precision and Stability, Surface Treatments, Misalignment Compensation, Lubrication Flexibility, Shaft Hardness. Applications : Medical & Laboratory Equipment, Robotics & Automation, Textile & Printing Machinery, Automotive Systems, Food & Beverage Industry, Office Automation, Multi-Axis Drilling Machines, Semiconductor Manufacturing. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The LMEK series integrates a square flange, allowing the bearing to be mounted directly to a moving body with screws, which simplifies assembly and saves space. The \"LMK\" series (Asian Standard), the \"LMEK\" series follows European metric dimensions, which is critical for shaft and housing compatibility. Material : High-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2), which is heat-treated and ground on both inner and outer surfaces for high rigidity and precision. Features are : High Speed & Low Noise, Durability and Longevity, Squareness & Accuracy, Minimal Friction & No Stick-Slip, Lubrication & Maintenance, Full Interchangeability, Dynamic Load Testing. Applications : 3D Printers & CNC Routers, Office Equipment, Packaging Machinery, Machine Tools, Medical Diagnostic Equipment, Automotive Mechanisms. L=Extra Long, U=One Side Seal.

The Samick LMEFP...UU bearing is a professional-grade European Standard circular pilot flanged linear bushing. It is specifically designed to provide high-precision linear motion with a built-in mounting interface that simplifies machine assembly by eliminating the need for separate housings. Material : The outer sleeve and balls are made of High Carbon Chromium Bearing Steel (SUJ2). A polymer (resin) retainer is standard, though steel retainers are available for high-temperature or vacuum environments. Features are : High Precision and Rigidity, Smooth and Low-Friction Motion, Self-Aligning Capability, Ease of Installation, High-Speed Efficiency, Variable Ball Row Orientation, Enhanced Surface Treatments, Shaft Requirements. Applications : Conveyor Systems, CNC Routers & Lathes, Packaging & Food Processing Machinery, Printing & Paper Equipment, Textile Machinery, Medical & Laboratory Equipment. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

Material : The outer sleeve and balls are made of High Carbon Chromium Bearing Steel (SUJ2). A polymer (resin) retainer is standard, though steel retainers are available for high-temperature or vacuum environments. Features are : High Precision and Rigidity, Smooth and Low-Friction Motion, Self-Aligning Capability, Ease of Installation, High-Speed Efficiency, Variable Ball Row Orientation, Enhanced Surface Treatments, Shaft Requirements. Applications : Conveyor Systems, CNC Routers & Lathes, Packaging & Food Processing Machinery, Printing & Paper Equipment, Textile Machinery, Medical & Laboratory Equipment. U=One Side Seal.

The SAMICK LMEFPL...UU bearing is a European standard, long-type linear motion bushing distinguished by its circular pilot flange. This specific flange design is engineered to handle moment loads more effectively by providing a stable mounting surface that allows the bushing to be installed directly into machine parts without the need for an external housing. Material : High carbon steel (SUJ2) for the outer sleeve and balls, with a polymer retainer as standard. Features are : Reduced Friction and Vibration, Tight Machining Tolerances, Moment Load Stability, Enhanced Travel Life, Standardized Interchangeability, Maintenance-Free Operation, Self-Aligning Capability, High Dynamic Capacity. Applications : Food Packaging & Processing, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Robotics & Aerospace, Medical Equipment, Textile & Printing Machinery, Material Handling Shuttles, Woodworking & Construction Machinery. L=Extra Long, UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

The Samick LMEFM...UU bearing is a European Standard middle-flanged linear bushing, offering high stability and precise linear motion without the need for a separate housing. Its distinctive \"Middle Flange\" design makes it ideal for applications where loads are passed directly to the bushing, providing stable movement even when moment loads occur on both sides of the moving body. The bearing features five internal rows of steel balls that circulate between the shaft and the raceway for smooth, low-friction motion. Material : High carbon steel (SUJ2) for the outer sleeve and balls, with a synthetic resin retainer. Features are : Standardized Interchangeability, High Load Capacity, Operating Temperature, High Acceleration Support, Stick-Slip Prevention, Self-Alignment Compatibility, Moment Load Stability, Space-Saving Assembly. Applications : Industrial Automation & Robotics, Multi-Axis Drilling & Punching, CNC Machines, Medical & Laboratory Equipment, Semiconductor Fabrication, 3D Measuring Equipment, Printing Machinery, Packaging & Food Processing. UU=Rubber Seals (NBR) On Both Sides.

Material : High carbon steel (SUJ2) outer sleeve with high carbon steel balls with a synthetic resin retainer. Features are : High-Precision Motion, Smooth Ball Circulation, Low Friction & Noise, Submicron Feeding Accuracy, Infinite Stroke Capability, Travel Life Factors, Speed and Acceleration, Temperature Limits. Appplications : Packaging and Labeling, Textile and Printing, CNC Machinery, 3D Printers & Plotters, Robotic Arms & Joints, Medical Imaging, Laboratory Automation, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Agricultural Equipment, Logistics & Material Handling, Woodworking Machinery, Food & Beverage Processing. U=One Side Seal.

Material : The outer sleeve and balls are made of high-carbon chromium bearing steel (SUJ2) for maximum hardness and wear resistance, while the internal retainer is typically resin (plastic) to minimize noise. Features are : Quiet Operation, Ready-to-Install, Lubrication System, Wide Temperature Range, Low Friction & Smooth Motion, Self-Alignment Capability, Moment Load Resistance, Standardized Interchangeability. Applications : Automation & Robotics, CNC & Digital Fabrication, Multi-Axis Drilling Machines, Textile Machinery, Medical & Semiconductor Manufacturing,  Food Packing Machine, Computer & IT Peripherals, Cutting & Printing. W=Wide (Long Type), S=Stainless Steel Ball.

desc: Linear Plain Bearing And Housing Unit
tech: The INA PAGBAO-PP-AS bearing is a linear plain bearing and housing unit. It features an open design with a segment cutout, making it suitable for use on supported shafts where high loads must be absorbed under relatively slow movements. As a plain bearing (using a friction bushing), it provides a significantly larger contact area than ball bearings. This makes it superior for impact resistance and applications involving high static or dynamic loads where vibration damping is critical. Material : The housing is typically made of aluminum, providing a high-strength yet lightweight solution. Features are : Precision and Quietness, High Load Capacity, Temperature Resilience, Maintenance Efficiency, Shaft Requirements. Applications : Agricultural Equipment, Industrial Automation & Robotics, Drive Technology & Mechanical Systems, Food & Packaging, Medical & Lab Equipment, Machine Tools & Manufacturing, Semiconductor & Electronics. PP=With End Wipers In The End Pieces, AS=Lubrication Holes In The Outer Ring Or Lubrication Groove In The Housing.

This specific geometry ensures uniform load distribution and high rigidity whether the load is radial, axial, or a moment load. This specific geometry ensures uniform load distribution and high rigidity whether the load is radial, axial, or a moment load. Material : The rails and blocks are constructed from hardened alloy steel, providing extreme wear resistance and maintaining long-term precision under heavy use. Features are :Operating Speed and Acceleration, Flexible Block Configurations, Self-Lubricating Wipers, Sealed Lubrication Cycle, Wide Temperature Range, Vibration Dampenin. Applications : Machine Tools & CNC, Robotics & Automation, Packaging & Logistics, Healthcare & Medical Technology, Textile Machinery, Printing & Paper Processing, Woodworking Equipment, Medical & Laboratory Science, Semiconductor Assembly, Renewable Energy. W=Wide Block Profile.

THREAD=M5. The GGY...AA(AB) is a heavy-duty, rolling arc linear motion guide derived fundamentally from the four-direction equal load GGB precision linear guide system. By arranging localized modular blocks along a fixed-radius track, the system scales smoothly. Theoretically, the larger the diameter of the GGY system, the easier it becomes to design, install, and maintain. Material : Manufactured from high-hardness, wear-resistant alloy steel for corrosive or cleanroom environments. Features are : Low Rolling Friction, High Motion Precision, Modular Scaleability, Self-Aligning Capability, High-Speed Acceleration Tolerance, Low Noise and Vibration, Balanced Moment Load Resistance, Long Service Intervals. Applications : CNC Machine Tools, Packaging Machining, Semiconductor Handling, Print & Paper Processing, Renewable Energy Trackers, Textile Machinery, Food & Beverage Processing, Aerospace, Defense, & Marine Systems. THREAD=M4. GZV refer to components in precision industrial motion control, specifically crossed roller linear guide systems used in manufacturing and automation machinery. GZV designates a precise format of a Crossed Roller V-Groove Linear Guide Rail System. Unlike recirculating blocks that run infinitely on a long rail, crossed roller systems move on a fixed, non-recirculating caged track optimized for exceptionally fluid travel over shorter strokes. Applications : Semiconductor Wafer Fabrication, Medical Diagnostic & Laboratory Instrumentation, Aerospace & Defence Testing, Woodworking Machinery, Textile & Printing Presses, Material Handling & Logistics Systems, Packaging & Palletizing Machinery, Metal Stamping & Forming Presses.

The GZD is a high-rigidity, ultra-heavy-load roller linear guide block manufactured by AZI. The "GZD" series represents specialized high-end variants derived from their standard heavy-load rolling linear guide technologies. Unlike standard ball-bearing guides, the GZD series utilizes cylindrical rolling elements. The contact interface between the rollers and the precision-ground raceway is linear rather than point-contact. This design maximizes load-bearing surface area, eliminating elastic deformation under stressful forces.The rollers are configured at a 45° contact angle relative to the internal rail raceways. This setup ensures equal load capacity in all four primary directions: radial, reverse-radial, and both lateral side-to-side directions. Material : Constructed from high-rigidity bearing steel and features end caps with integrated dust-proof rubber seals to prevent contamination. Features are : Interchangeable Standardization, Low Inertia Friction:, Stick-Slip Prevention, Tight Tolerances, Lifespan & Thermal Management, Vibration Dampening, Symmetrical Lubrication Inlets. Applications :Palletizing & Material Handling, Aerospace Components Machining , Energy & Infrastructure Production, Machine Tools & CNC Machinery, Packaging and Food Machinery.

The four rows of recirculating balls are aligned in an O-shape structure. This design maximizes rigidity and provides high resistance against moment forces (torsion and twisting) from all directions. The standard version utilizes a full complement ball set to achieve the maximum possible dynamic and static load ratings within its compact envelope. Material : Made from through-hardened carbon rolling-element steel with high-quality NBR rubber elastic end seals. Features are : Advanced Lubrication Mechanics, System Modularity & Interchangeability, Extended Service Life, Low Friction Heating, High Velocity Limits, Extreme Temperature Threshold. Applications : Machine Tools & Metalworking, Woodworking Equipment, Electronic & Semiconductor Production, Logistics & Material Handling, Energy & Aerospace Systems. KUVE=Four-Row Linear Recirculating Ball Bearing and Guideway Assembly, B=Generation/Design Modification Code.

The four rows of recirculating balls are aligned in an O-shape structure. This design maximizes rigidity and provides high resistance against moment forces (torsion and twisting) from all directions. The standard version utilizes a full complement ball set to achieve the maximum possible dynamic and static load ratings within its compact envelope. Material : Made from through-hardened carbon rolling-element steel with high-quality NBR rubber elastic end seals. Features are : Advanced Lubrication Mechanics, System Modularity & Interchangeability, Extended Service Life, Low Friction Heating, High Velocity Limits, Extreme Temperature Threshold. Applications : Machine Tools & Metalworking, Woodworking Equipment, Electronic & Semiconductor Production, Logistics & Material Handling, Energy & Aerospace Systems. KUVE=Four-Row Linear Recirculating Ball Bearing and Guideway Assembly, B=Generation/Design Modification Code.

These bearing is a four-row miniature linear recirculating ball bearing and guideway assembly. These bearing is a four-row linear recirculating ball bearing monorail guidance system manufactured by INA. The steel balls circulate in four tracks within the block, making contact with the rail profiles at a specific angle. The O-arrangement positions the friction lines outwards, giving the assembly high moment rigidity. This ensures the system handles pitching, yawing, and rolling moments efficiently without binding. Features are : Integral Lubrication Pocket, High Acceleration Thresholds, High-Velocity Rating, Operating Temperature Range, Low Friction Coefficient, Extended Service Intervals, Low Noise & Vibration Damping. Applications : Medical Technology & Laboratory Automation, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Packaging & Material Handling, Aerospace and Defense Systems, Textile and Printing Machinery, Woodworking & Plastics Processing. B=Generation Design, H=High Carriage Design, U=Under-Carriage (Internal) Sealing Strips, W2=Two Carriages (Blocks), KD=Guideway / Rail Precision Processing Classification, AAAA=Factory Execution (Preload & Accuracy).

This narrow, standard-length runner block is engineered for monorail guidance systems that require heavy load support, high rigidity, and minimal friction. The balls contact the raceways in an \"O\" shape configuration. This specific arrangement provides superior resistance to roll moments and balances load forces equally in all four direction lines: upward, downward, and lateral. Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Machine Tooling & Fabrication, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. This specific arrangement provides superior resistance to roll moments and balances load forces equally in all four direction lines: upward, downward, and lateral. Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, ESC=Expanded Design, Short, Narrow Carriage, KD=Guideway / Rail Precision Processing Classification, UG=Un-Greased, V2=Preload Class 2, G3=Precision Class 3.

This geometric design allows the block to absorb high forces from all directions (tension, compression, and lateral loads) as well as high moment loads around all axes. Material : Manufactured from high-grade, through-hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6). Features are : Interchangeability and Modular Setup, High-Speed and Acceleration Performance, Lubricant Distribution Channels, Reduced Noise, Wide Broad Thermal Range, Extended Service Intervals. Applications : Machine Tools & CNC Equipment, Material Handling Systems, Medical, Laboratory & Cleanroom Technology, Electronic & Semiconductor Assembly, Packaging & Printing Machinery. B=Generation Design, L=Long Carriage Block, RROC=Corrotect® Anti-Corrosion Coating, V2=Preload Class 2, G3=Precision Class 3.

It allows the carriage to absorb equal dynamic and static forces from all radial directions (up/down forces) and lateral directions (side loads). It also manages high moment loads around all three physical axes. Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Easy Maintenance and Lubrication, Smooth Movement and Low Friction, High-Speed Capabilities, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Broad Temperature Threshold, Enhanced Fatigue Life. Applications : Machine Tooling & Fabrication, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, EC=Expanded Design, Short Carriage, UG=Un-Greased, KD=Guideway / Rail Precision Processing Classification, V2=Preload Class 2, G3=Precision Class 3.

These bearing is a high-performance four-row linear recirculating ball bearing carriage manufactured by INA. This narrow, standard-length runner block is engineered for monorail guidance systems that require heavy load support, high rigidity, and minimal friction. The balls contact the raceways in an \"O\" shape configuration. This specific arrangement provides superior resistance to roll moments and balances load forces equally in all four direction lines: upward, downward, and lateral. Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Machine Tooling & Fabrication, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, ES=Expanded Design, Narrow Carriage, UG=Un-Greased, RROC=Corrotect® Anti-Corrosion Coating, V1=Slight Preload, G3=Precision Class 3.

This specific arrangement provides superior resistance to roll moments and balances load forces equally in all four direction lines: upward, downward, and lateral. Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, ESC=Expanded Design, Short, Narrow Carriage, ADK=Advanced Sealing Kit, V0=Little To No Preload, G3=Precision Class 3.

The steel balls contact the raceways at an angle forming an \"O\" shape geometry. This configuration provides uniform load distribution, enabling the carriage to withstand upward, downward, and lateral loads equally. Material : Manufactured from high-grade, through-hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6). Features are : Low Wave Travel Motion, Flexible Maintenance Access, Integrated Lubrication Channels, Operating Temperature Limits, Interchangeable Modular Design, Low Kinetic Friction, High-Speed Performance & Acceleration. Applications : Machine Tools and Metalworking, Medical and Laboratory Equipment, Semiconductor and Electronics Manufacturing, Packaging and Printing Technology, Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing, Woodworking Machinery, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, H=High Carriage, UG=Un-Greased, V2=Preload Class 2, G3=Precision Class 3.

This allows the block to support equal loads from all radial directions (downward, upward, and lateral forces). Material : Manufactured from high-grade, through-hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6). Features are : Interchangeability and Modular Setup, High-Speed and Acceleration Performance, Lubricant Distribution Channels, Reduced Noise, Wide Broad Thermal Range, Extended Service Intervals. Applications : Machine Tools & CNC Equipment, Material Handling Systems, Medical, Laboratory & Cleanroom Technology, Electronic & Semiconductor Assembly, Packaging & Printing Machinery. W=Wide Carriage, L=Long Carriage Design, UG=Un-Greased, V1=Slight Preload, G2=Precision Class 2.

The steel balls contact the raceways at an angle forming an \"O\" shape geometry. This configuration provides uniform load distribution, enabling the carriage to withstand upward, downward, and lateral loads equally. Material : Manufactured from high-grade, through-hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6). Features are : Low Wave Travel Motion, Flexible Maintenance Access, Integrated Lubrication Channels, Operating Temperature Limits, Interchangeable Modular Design, Low Kinetic Friction, High-Speed Performance & Acceleration. Applications : Machine Tools and Metalworking, Medical and Laboratory Equipment, Semiconductor and Electronics Manufacturing, Packaging and Printing Technology, Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing, Woodworking Machinery, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, HL=High, Long Carriage, ADK=Advanced Sealing Kit, V0=Little To No Preload, G1=Precision Class 1.

The balls contact the rail at specific angles that form an \"O\" shape. This layout provides very high rigidity. It allows the carriage to handle heavy forces from all directions (downward, upward, and sideways). Material : Manufactured from high-grade, through-hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6). Features are : Interchangeable Design Layout, Built-in Lubricant Reservoir, High-Speed Acceleration Thresholds, Wide Temperature Resilience, Vibration Dampening Design,  Reduced Noise, Extended Service Intervals. Applications : Machine Tools & CNC Equipment, Material Handling Systems, Medical, Laboratory & Cleanroom Technology, Electronic & Semiconductor Assembly, Packaging & Printing Machinery. B=Generation Design, SN=Slim/Narrow, Low Carriage, V0=Little To No Preload, G1=Precision Class 1.

This block features four rows of balls arranged in an O-configuration. This design provides high rigidity and exceptional moment-load capacities across all axes. Features are : Low Wave Travel Motion, Flexible Maintenance Access, Integrated Lubrication Channels, Operating Temperature Limits, Interchangeable Modular Design, Low Kinetic Friction, High-Speed Performance & Acceleration. Applications : Machine Tools and Metalworking, Medical and Laboratory Equipment, Semiconductor and Electronics Manufacturing, Packaging and Printing Technology, Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing, Woodworking Machinery, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, E=Expanded Design, UG=Un-Greased, V1=Little To No Preload, G3=Precision Class 3.

These bearing is a Linear Bearing is a premium four-row recirculating linear ball bearing carriage. The internal steel balls circulate in four separate tracks. This ensures the carriage can carry heavy loads from all directions (pushing down, pulling up, or pushing from the side). The ball tracks are arranged in a wide "O" shape inside the block. This design creates a wide spacing between the load lines, giving the carriage excellent resistance to tipping and twisting moments (high moment rigidity). Material : The carriage body and raceways are constructed from high-grade, through-hardened carbon chromium rolling bearing steel. Features are : Low Noise Optimization, Modular Interchangeability, Universal Lubrication Ports, High Acceleration Capacity, Low Noise and Vibration Dampening, Extreme Temperature Range, Smooth Movement and Low Friction. Applications : Machine Tooling & Fabrication, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, EC=Expanded Design, Short Carriage, KD=Guideway / Rail Precision Processing Classification, V2=Preload Class 2, G3=Precision Class 3.

It offers superior resistance to rotational forces (roll, pitch, and yaw), preventing the block from binding or twisting on the rail. Material : Manufactured from high-grade, through-hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6). Features are : Flexible and Easy Maintenance, Interchangeability and Modular System, Extreme Speed and Acceleration Limits, Maximum Stiffness, Low-Profile Structure, Wide Thermal Range, Minimal Friction Variance, Extended Life, Low-Noise & Vibration. Applications : Machine Tooling & Fabrication, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Woodworking & Timber Processing, Renewable Energy Production. B=Generation Design, NL=Low, Long Carriage, KD=Guideway / Rail Precision Processing Classification, V2=Preload Class 2, G3=Precision Class 3.
